tasks.statement:
Newcastle is at the lowest bridging point on the Thyne, and stands on its northern bank. The city covers a
roughly semi-circular area extending for four kilometres in all directions. Across the river lies Newcastle's twin -
Gateshead - covering about half the area of Newcastle.

Which map fits the description in the text? (analysing maps)
a. Map 1
b. Map 2
c. Both maps
d. Neither of the two maps
